title: Chaos Control
native_title: カオス・コントロール
overview:
The year is 2050, and the alien Kesh Rhan have launched an invasion of Earth. Fighter pilot Jessica Darkhill of the Orbital Defence Forces, out to avenge the death of her fiance, is sent into battle to drive the invaders back.

Chaos Control is a first-person 3D shooter. Your fighter flies a set course through computer-graphics scenery while you sweep a crosshair across the screen to shoot down enemy craft before they wear down your shields. Fight over Manhattan around the Statue of Liberty, inside a virtual world of circuitry and viruses, and out in space against an enemy fleet, a giant carrier and the space colony Solaris.

- Shuttle Mouse compatible
